ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/off-white) to low-intensity (black/dark-brown) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white intensity across the central and upper regions of both lobes; large contiguous low-intensity black region surrounding the median notch and extending along the lower trailing edge; secondary low-intensity clusters at both distal lateral tips; localized yellowish-brown pixel patches on the lower mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 42 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration profile; distinct sawtooth-like peaks with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels from the mean boundary line; approximately 20-25 distinct serration points visible per lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer leading edges exhibit a convex mathematical curve; trailing edges follow a macro-concave path from the distal tips toward the median notch, modulated by high-frequency serrations.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular, high-contrast dark pixel clusters (black rings or solid spots) scattered across the white regions of both lobes, concentrated heavily in the mid-ventral zones.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical high-intensity (white) linear disruption within the low-intensity black region of the right lobe; several smaller unaligned linear marks on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of live barnacles (Coronula diadema) and associated structural build-up at both lateral tips; irregular micro-notches in the trailing edge serration pattern indicating mechanical wear.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-orange biological staining (likely diatom film) localized on the ventral surface of the left lobe, creating a distinct color gradient against the white pigmentation.
